# Local Foundation candidate

`workspace-ui` 0.1.0 is a local candidate packed from App Foundation. Both products consume the exact tarball; source and GPL-3.0-only attribution are included. It contains no product credentials, identity storage or API configuration. SHA-256 is recorded in SHA256SUMS. Publish an immutable Foundation release before product release.

Registration UI 0.1.0: local extraction candidate containing both ICP and public security links and the CubeRoot badge. Both products pin the identical packed artifact; no cross-repository runtime imports. Not yet published; replace this local candidate pin with an immutable release before product release.

Icons 0.1.0: local candidate for contact brand icons and full Lucide exports. Same packed artifact in both sites; ESM/CJS, upstream licenses retained, host Lucide version remains a peer. Publish immutable artifact before release.

Navigation UI 0.1.0: local shared sidebar candidate from App Foundation; both sites pin the same artifact. Mira workbenches and CubeRoot internal workspace consume it. Not published; use an immutable release before deployment.

Navigation UI 0.1.2 is the current local candidate: adds grouped menus, count badges and embedded content without nested main landmarks. Mira admin/notifications and CubeRoot contact also consume it; both sites pin identical bytes. Unpublished.

Careers UI 0.1.0 is a shared local candidate for the careers browser and detail sections. Both sites pin the same artifact; positions, labels, routes and styling remain host-owned. Publish an immutable artifact before deployment.
